name: Purified Kor Gem
summary: At Jordan Stilwell’s forge outside Ironforge, a Purified Kor Gem is needed to shape a weapon of the Light. First, elven magic must cleanse the corrupted stone.

sections.title: From Corruption to Sanctity
sections.body: Naga hold the Corrupted Kor Gem in Blackfathom Deeps, beneath Ashenvale’s coast. A paladin carries it to Thundris Windweaver, a night elf in Auberdine. There, Thundris draws on arcane and natural arts to purge its aquatic and shadowy taint. The stone emerges purified, ready to channel holy power.

sections.title: The Smith's Masterpiece
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell, a human weaponsmith outside Ironforge, needs the gem for a masterwork weapon. He has long held designs for a weapon worthy of the Silver Hand, but lacked the rare materials to forge it. The Purified Kor Gem, Whitestone Oak Lumber, and rare ore give the weapon its spiritual core, to channel a paladin’s righteous wrath.

faq.q: What is the Purified Kor Gem used for?
aliases: why do i need kor gem
faq.answer: The gem goes to Jordan Stilwell, the blacksmith outside Ironforge in Dun Morogh. He uses it to forge a consecrated weapon for a paladin undertaking their trials.
Naga hold the corrupted stone in Blackfathom Deeps, beneath the coast of Ashenvale.
Thundris Windweaver, a night elf in Auberdine, cleanses the Corrupted Kor Gem and restores it to a purified state.

faq.q: Can any adventurer make use of the Purified Kor Gem?
aliases: can anyone use purified kor gem
faq.answer: Paladins undergoing the Test of Righteousness seek the gem. Jordan Stilwell crafts for holy warriors who bring him the purified crystal and other rare materials.

angles.text: As a paladin, you prove your devotion by acquiring and cleansing this gem. Then you carry it from Kalimdor to Dun Morogh, where it helps forge a weapon of the Light.
As an Alliance member, you rely on night elven wisdom in Auberdine to aid a human smith on the slopes of Dun Morogh.
